Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1047
Claimant:
Heather Nelson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
5-6-25
Claim received for a collision at an intersection in whcih the insured vehicle was turning left and was struck on the
driver's side by another vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
7-2-25
Reviewed the photos submitted by the insured, which show damage to the left front quarter panel and door that lines
up with the impact described in the first report. Body shop estimate requested.
7-18-25
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the sequence of events as the insured described it. Independent witness
statement obtained and it matches the same account.
7-31-25
Police report obtained. It records the collision location, the direction of travel of both vehicles, and the damage noted
at the scene, all conisstent with the claim.
8-19-25
Claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact. Medical records requested through counsel. The injury type and the
focre of the crash appear consistent with one another based on the vehicle damage review.
8-21-25
Claimant's account has been the same in each contact so far, including the first call, the recorded statement, and the
follow-up with counsel present. Exact seating position in the vehicle at impact is still not fully clear and is being
followed up.
9-25-25
Vehicle history checked. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the damage predates the
policy effective period. Prior medical history for the same body area has been requested and none is known so far.
10-28-25
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this type of fracture. Records show the claimant has been seen
by several providers, and the billing is being reviewed against the treatment notes.
11-21-25
Confirmed that the driver involved is a household member of the policyholder and qualifies as a covered driver under
the policy.
11-25-25
File is progressing toward a settlement evaluation once the remaining medical records and the seating position
question are resolved. Next review scheduled with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
